questions.question: What will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘–’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged? 152 ÷ 6 + 1617 × 7 – 77 = ?
questions.questionHtml:
What will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘–’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?
152 ÷ 6 + 1617 × 7 – 77 = ?
questions.solution:
Given equation: 152 ÷ 6 + 1617 × 7 – 77 = ?

After interchanging the signs then:

⇒ 152 × 6 - 1617 ÷ 7 + 77 = ? ⇒ 152 × 6 - 231 + 77 ⇒  912 - 231 + 77 
⇒ 989 - 231 = 758

questions.question: 21 is related to 220 by certain logic. Following the same logic, 72 is related to 781. To which of the following is 27 related, following the same logic? questions.solution: Logic: (1st number × 10) + (1st number - 11) = 2nd number. Similarly, for 27 ∶ ? ⇒ (27 × 10) + (27 - 11) = 270 + 16 = 286.

questions.question: Which two numbers (not digits) should be interchanged to make the given equation correct? 6 × 3 + 8 ÷ 2 + 21 + 5 × 4 – 14 ÷ 7 = 53
questions.questionHtml:
Which two numbers (not digits) should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?
6 × 3 + 8 ÷ 2 + 21 + 5 × 4 – 14 ÷ 7 = 53
questions.solution:
Option 4) 21 and 14

Two numbers need to be interchanged then:

⇒ 6 × 3 + 8 ÷ 2 + 14 + 5 × 4 – 21 ÷ 7 = 53

⇒ 6 × 3 + 4 + 14 + 5 × 4 – 3 = 53

⇒ 18 + 4 + 14 + 20 – 3 = 53

⇒ 56 – 3 = 53

⇒ 53 = 53
